approved_plan.recommended_name: PURE RLOO core, Qwen-PRM, single-A100 LoRA adaptation
approved_plan.recommended_execution: Reuse audited current single-process generation/LoRA infrastructure; port pinned PURE math into a separate trainer. Do not replace the old environment with the old official distributed stack.

comparisons.primary: P_PRM minus P_VR: matched new implementation, models, data, optimizer and budget; reward source differs
comparisons.historical: Keep A_GRPO and B_MIX as original references; differences versus P arms are whole-recipe comparisons, not isolated reward/credit-assignment effects
comparisons.deferred: Only if a min-form mechanism claim is needed: a matched signed sum-form arm. Do not label P_PRM minus B_MIX an isolated min-form ablation.

proposed_shared_settings.initialization: same original base and seed17 LoRA initialization as corrected A/B; never continue A/B final checkpoints for this comparison
proposed_shared_settings.learning_rate_reason: fixed official verl config default, shared by P_VR/P_PRM; differs from old LoRA A/B 5e-6 and paper PRM-only 5e-7
proposed_shared_settings.prompt: unchanged original corrected A/B prompt; no final_only or official separator-instruction prompt substitution
proposed_shared_settings.whitening_scope: once across valid tokens of the complete 32-response generation batch, before microbatching
proposed_shared_settings.loss_reduction: official compute_policy_loss per static one-response microbatch; accumulate 1/32. Shared by P_VR and P_PRM; not a full global token-mean substitution.
proposed_shared_settings.budget_status: proposal only; no new launch authorized or dispatched
proposed_shared_settings.evaluation: fixed final budget checkpoint; common original greedy MATH500 (500) and GSM8K (1319), max new tokens 2048, existing frozen verifier, no PRM reranking

P_VR.verifiable_reward: existing repaired outcome at last valid response token

P_PRM.coverage: all generated responses, independent of final-answer parsing/correctness; no inherited B valid_for_prm gate
P_PRM.native_interface: AutoModel trust_remote_code with <extra_0> and Qwen chat template; PRM-only canonical CRLF view, raw actor output unchanged
P_PRM.step_to_actor_mapping: explicit raw-character span to original actor completion-token end index; last step goes to EOS when present or final generated token when truncated
P_PRM.empty_response: one terminal step, native Qwen assistant <extra_0> input; score and report separately, do not substitute a hand-designed penalty
P_PRM.context_overflow_or_alignment_failure: fail the batch and preserve evidence; never silently truncate, replace the score with zero, or drop/reweight that sample

necessary_adaptations: Official PRM checkpoint replaced with existing Qwen PRM and its native scoring API
Single GPU LoRA and current validated inference engine replace official full-parameter distributed workers
32 rather than 512 generated responses per full batch; static microbatch one
2048 completion tokens instead of paper 8192 / public default YAML 7168
Existing data, prompt and frozen verifier retained instead of repository data/forced prompt/grader
Official default curriculum filter explicitly disabled for both new arms
FP32 score processing based on existing Qwen scorer; not a bit-exact BF16 logits reproduction
must_not_claim: full reproduction of published PURE accuracy
PURE training already smoke-tested on GPU
old A vs new PURE isolates only reward
acceptance_before_training: Pin and preserve existing A/B and new source/config hashes
CPU tensor parity against pinned official signed transform, return, RLOO, whitening and PPO functions
Replay exact token ids with CRLF, multiple newline forms, whitespace-only, EOS and truncated cases; assert each native PRM score maps once to a valid actor position

Real-model no-update forward plus backward without optimizer.step, after separate authorization/resource availability; record total-process CUDA peak, throughput, finite gradients and unchanged parameter hashes
Assert P_PRM advantages do not change if gold answers are permuted; P_VR must respond to outcome labels
Assert fixed N=2048 even for all-short batches and no additional TRL group normalization or per-microbatch whitening
Compare chosen static microbatch gradient accumulation to official reference on a tiny deterministic batch
Verify native Qwen PRM has no new/missing scoring-head parameters and remains frozen
Only after user launch authorization, register distinct runs and resumable receipts; no automatic launch from this plan
